status: AI-assisted provisional research QA only; not independent human evaluation
interface: ChatGPT with linked GitHub repository connector
annotator: ChatGPT (GPT-6); not Claude and not a human
method: Programmatic ingestion of every pack review, grouped counts and textual pattern scans; direct inspection of selected positive/negative and safety/authenticity excerpts per product. Provisional card labels and claim-risk triage are GPT-6 judgments, not exhaustive independent human readings of all 5946 reviews.
blinding: NOT blind. The system's existing assessment and both system summaries were visible in the same review session. Therefore cards must not be treated as independent reference judgments.
rubric: research/product_specific_conclusions/human_eval_pack/INSTRUCTIONS.md, applied provisionally with uncertainty; disputed safety/authenticity claims are unverified reviewer allegations.

outputs.purpose: Provisional five-way card assessment, safety, authenticity, evidence review numbers and confidence
Potential unsupported or understated safety/authenticity claims in two wordings per product; not numeric human ratings
Recomputes 35 product-level descriptive agreement and 70-summary issue triage without claiming true accuracy
Bounded AI-only quality report, gaps, and user-approved methodological scope

known_limitations: Only a subset of the 5946 review texts was directly read by the model; regex-like scans are not a substitute for human semantic review.
Stars may be inconsistent with review sentiment or stratified in the source pool and were not used alone as evidence.
Review text can contain marketplace suggestion lists, unrelated content, and possible privacy-sensitive material.
Safety, authentic-product and FDA allegations are customer claims, not externally verified facts.
Output does not constitute annotation A or B, adjudicated truth, two independent AI sets, or independent human evaluation.
human_action: No human annotators requested for the AI-only exploratory study. Original human-only pack remains untouched. If an independent evaluation is undertaken in the future, the AI triage must not be shown during blinded reference labeling.

study_method_amendment.instruction: Project owner elected to use AI annotations without recruiting human annotators for the exploratory study.
study_method_amendment.scope: AI-only descriptive research/quality audit; no independent human evaluation performed.
study_method_amendment.comparison_note: The GPT-6 annotator saw the system card and summaries during review; agreement is not accuracy.
study_method_amendment.human_reference_status: not planned for the selected exploratory methodology; old blank pack retained as historical protocol
study_method_amendment.production_decision: unchanged; release blocked pending separate evidence, staging and safety gates
